statements.source_text: The lights prescribed in these Rules shall have an intensity as specified in Section 8 Annex I to these Regulation
statements.predicate: The prescribed lights shall have the intensity specified in Section 8 of Annex I.

statements.source_text: In vessels of 50 metres or more in length
statements.predicate: The following minimum visibility ranges apply to vessels of 50 metres or more in length.
A masthead light shall be visible at a minimum range of 6 miles.
A sidelight shall be visible at a minimum range of 3 miles.
A sternlight shall be visible at a minimum range of 3 miles.
A towing light shall be visible at a minimum range of 3 miles.

statements.source_text: a white, red, green or yellow all-round light, 3 miles
statements.predicate: A white, red, green or yellow all-round light shall be visible at a minimum range of 3 miles.
